title: -ing (2) 목적어 (I enjoy cooking.)
goal: enjoy, finish, mind 같은 동사 뒤에 -ing를 붙여 '~하는 것을'이라고 말할 수 있어요.

points.title: 동사 뒤에 오는 -ing
points.body: -ing는 동사 뒤에서 '~하는 것을'이라는 뜻으로도 써요. I enjoy cooking.(저는 요리하는 걸 즐겨요.) 동사 두 개를 그냥 붙이면(enjoy cook) 틀려요.

points.title: -ing와 짝꿍인 동사
points.body: enjoy(즐기다), finish(끝내다), mind(꺼리다), avoid(피하다), keep(계속하다), practise(연습하다), stop(그만두다 — 단, stop to + 동사원형은 "~하려고 멈추다"라는 다른 뜻), give up(포기하다). 이 동사들 뒤에는 -ing를 써요. 통째로 외워 두세요.

points.title: Do you mind ~ing? = ~해 주실래요?
points.body: 직역은 '~하는 걸 꺼리세요?'라서, 괜찮다고 할 때는 No, not at all.(아뇨, 전혀요.)이라고 대답해요. 일터에서 부탁할 때 아주 많이 써요.

points.title: about / for 뒤에도 -ing
points.body: How about ~ing?(~하는 거 어때요?), Thank you for ~ing.(~해 줘서 고마워요.)처럼 about, for 같은 말 뒤에도 -ing가 와요.

points.title: 시제는 앞 동사가 담당
points.body: 과거라도 -ing는 그대로예요. 시제는 앞 동사가 바꿔요. He stopped smoking.(O) / He stopped smoked.(X)

formula: 주어 + enjoy / finish / mind / avoid + 동사-ing
주어 + keep / practise / stop / give up + 동사-ing

mistakes.wrong: I enjoy to surf on weekends.
mistakes.why: enjoy는 -ing하고만 짝이에요. '서핑하는 걸 즐겨요'는 enjoy surfing.

mistakes.wrong: Did you finish clean the kitchen?
mistakes.right: Did you finish cleaning the kitchen?
mistakes.why: 동사 두 개를 그냥 붙이면 안 돼요. finish 뒤의 동사는 -ing로 바꿔요.

mistakes.wrong: How about go to the beach?
mistakes.right: How about going to the beach?
mistakes.why: How about 뒤에는 동사원형이 아니라 -ing가 와요.

examples.en: Did you finish cleaning the kitchen?
Do you mind opening the window?
My housemate keeps leaving dishes in the sink.
I avoid eating out because it's expensive.
I practise speaking English every day.
How about going to the beach this afternoon?
examples.ko: 오늘 오후에 해변 가는 거 어때요?

quiz.why: Do you mind 뒤에는 -ing. close는 e를 빼고 closing.
practise + 동사-ing. drive는 e를 빼고 driving.

quiz.answer: I avoid spending too much money.
choices: I avoid spending too much money.
I avoid spend too much money.
I avoid spends too much money.
I avoiding spend too much money.

quiz.answer: Do you mind waiting a minute?
choices: Do you mind waiting a minute?
Do you mind wait a minute?
Do you mind waits a minute?
Do you minding wait a minute?

quiz.answer: She gave up looking for a job in the city.
choices: She gave up looking for a job in the city.
She gave up look for a job in the city.
She gave up looks for a job in the city.
She gave up to looking for a job in the city.
quiz.why: give up + 동사-ing. 사이에 to를 넣지 않아요.
